note: Family-owned since 1957, on Marble Lake near Quincy, 30 acres: private beach and boat ramps, dock rentals, ice cream, holiday-weekend events. Mostly seasonal: the rates page prices all 315 lots by the year; nightly, weekly and monthly stays are also sold, number of nightly sites not stated. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages: nightly $40 off-lake with electric / $50 lakefront full hookup (2025 rates page) confirmed; added water/sewer, showers, dump, water station, season Apr 15-Nov 1 (2025), phone-only booking, 315 sites. Phone (517) 639-8290 matches. Amperage not stated. Seasonal share: the rates page lists annual prices for lots 1-315 (all of them) and the About page says sites rent daily/weekly/monthly/annually; the number sold nightly is not given, so long-stay test 4 passes on 'no count'. Tests 1-3 pass ($40 posted nightly rate with phone, no minimum); test 5 passes (a 7-unit apartment building and a mobile-home rental beside 315 RV sites). No gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 132 km); the family has not stayed here. Note cleaned of hookup/store text.
flags: Mostly seasonal park (long-stay five tests): every one of the 315 lots carries an annual rate ($2,700-2,900/yr) on the 2025 rates page; nightly sites exist ($40 off-lake w/ electric, $50 lakefront full hookup) but their number is not stated. Passes tests 1-5 as published (posted nightly rate + phone, no minimum, no nightly count given, an RV park not a home community).
Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary operator claim): the operator sells 'Lakefront' full-hookup nightly sites ($50); the entry is 'not waterfront'.
